tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public applications, chatbot catalog and labeled news. Returns at most 24 stable IDs, titles and canonical citation URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public record ID returned by search. Includes citable text and dated facts. Unpublished and unknown IDs are unavailable.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare one to four distinct public tool IDs. Preserves unknown facts, source evidence and checked dates; no generated ratings.

tools.name: get_chatbot_brief
tools.description: Read the same source-reviewed brief shown on the homepage, with at most four labeled stories and related public tools. An empty brief remains empty.

tools.name: get_submission_instructions
tools.description: Anonymous, credential-free instructions for authenticated private submissions. Includes exact first-party OTP HTTP endpoints, bounded submission fields and binary screenshot uploads. No OAuth authentication is offered.

tools.name: verify_homepage_backlink
tools.description: Requires a verified builder Bearer token. Check a visible anchor to https://shellwire.com/ on the root homepage of your public HTTPS site. Authenticated bounded network check, cached for five minutes. No publication. Rate limited.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.description: Requires email OTP authentication and a verified root homepage backlink. Submit an app or personal agent for private operator review, with optional images uploaded separately by authenticated HTTP. Email must match the verified account. Does not publish. Repeated pending normalized URLs are acknowle

tools.name: list_my_submissions
tools.description: Requires a current verified builder token. Return only this builder account's private submission statuses, optional published tool URL and image previews. Empty means no owned records. Never returns another builder's submission, operator notes or contact email.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_homepage_backlink" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, list_my_submissions · Private data: fetch, get_submission_instructions, verify_homepage_backlink, submit_application, list_my_submissions · Public sink: submit_application, list_my_submissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, list_my_submissions · Private data: fetch, get_submission_instructions, verify_homepage_backlink, submit_application, list_my_submissions · Public sink: submit_application, list_my_submissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
